rationale: B is substantially clearer and more idiomatic: it derives the natural group counts directly from sorted title multiplicities, applies the single beneficial regrouping (5+3 to 4+4), and computes the price without A's iterative re-sorting and delicate greedy condition. Its comment claiming counts[i] is the number of titles with more than i copies is inaccurate, but the implementation and surrounding derivation remain easy to verify and less complex than A.
